worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.summary: Keep the target's existing types and add Grass: open weaknesses on a foe, or shelter an ally. The roots only show that layer and never bind the target.
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.use.0: add Grass and open Fire, Ice, Bug and Flying weaknesses
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.use.1: force a four-times Grass weakness on Water and Ground foes
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.use.2: add Grass to an ally to shelter it from Water, Electric, Grass and Ground, longer with deep roots
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.descripti: Add the Grass type to the target for %1$s; the roots only show that layer and never bind or root it in place.
Curse range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, following speed and size.
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.rooted.on: Deep roots: the curse lasts %1$s with a %2$s cooldown, and it winds up slower.
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.rooted.of: Shallow curse: a shorter curse with faster windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.preferenc: Deep roots: curse duration ×1.7, windup +3 ticks and cooldown +20 ticks. Shallow curse lasts less, winds up faster and reduces cooldown by 10 ticks.
The companion only considers cursing a threat within this distance; lower stays close, higher chases further.
When on, it will leave its post to lay the curse.
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.growth.0: From level %1$s, base cooldown is shortened by 0.5 s.
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.growth.1: From level %1$s, base cooldown is shortened by 1.1 s, replacing the previous growth reduction.
world_combat.move.forestscurse.text.curs: Cursed by the forest, Grass type added
world_combat.move.forestscurse.text.lift: The forest curse lifts; the Grass type fades
world_combat.move.forestscurse.text.noro: Already Grass or type layer full, no room for the curse
world_combat.move.forestscurse.text.fizz: No type to add to, the curse falls flat
world_combat.move.forestscurse.text.empt: Only a few leaves stir; no target to curse
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.descripti: It only works on a non-Grass Pokemon that currently has fewer than three types (so there is room to add one more): a target already Grass, whose type layer is full, or whose types are locked by an ability is not cursed. No curse zone is left on the ground, and an ally must be chosen explicitly.
